datasets.name: denial_reasons
queryLines:
SELECT
  denial_reason_code,
  COUNT(*) AS denial_count
FROM
  wavepoint_workshop.project_3_silver.claims_and_payments
WHERE
  claim_status = 'denied'
GROUP BY
  denial_reason_code
ORDER BY
  denial_count DESC

datasets.name: monthly_financials
queryLines:
SELECT
  month AS service_month,
  net_revenue AS revenue,
  outstanding_patient_balance AS patient_balance
FROM
  wavepoint_workshop.project_3_gold.gold_monthly_revenue
ORDER BY
  service_month

datasets.name: claims_status
queryLines:
SELECT
  claim_status,
  COUNT(*) AS claim_count,
  SUM(amount_claimed) AS total_claimed,
  SUM(amount_paid) AS total_paid
FROM
  wavepoint_workshop.project_3_silver.claims_and_payments
GROUP BY
  claim_status
ORDER BY
  claim_count DESC

datasets.name: appt_status
queryLines:
SELECT
  appointment_status,
  COUNT(*) AS appointment_count
FROM
  wavepoint_workshop.project_3_silver.appointments
GROUP BY
  appointment_status
ORDER BY
  appointment_count DESC

datasets.name: denial_analysis
queryLines:
SELECT
  company_name,
  total_claims,
  denied_claims,
  actual_denial_rate_pct AS denial_rate,
  avg_days_to_adjudicate,
  total_claimed,
  total_paid
FROM
  wavepoint_workshop.project_3_gold.gold_payer_performance
ORDER BY
  denial_rate DESC

datasets.name: dispute_outcomes
queryLines:
SELECT
  dispute_outcome,
  dispute_reason_category,
  COUNT(*) AS dispute_count,
  SUM(amount_recovered) AS total_recovered
FROM
  wavepoint_workshop.project_3_silver.claim_disputes
GROUP BY
  dispute_outcome,
  dispute_reason_category
ORDER BY
  dispute_count DESC

datasets.name: overview_kpis
queryLines:
SELECT
  total_patients,
  total_appointments,
  total_claims,
  total_revenue,
  denial_rate_pct AS denial_rate,
  no_show_rate_pct AS no_show_rate
FROM
  wavepoint_workshop.project_3_gold.gold_kpi_summary

datasets.name: network_comparison
queryLines:
SELECT
  network_status,
  COUNT(*) AS claim_count,
  SUM(amount_claimed) AS total_claimed,
  SUM(amount_paid) AS total_paid,
  ROUND(AVG(days_to_adjudicate), 1) AS avg_days
FROM
  wavepoint_workshop.project_3_silver.claims_and_payments
GROUP BY
  network_status

datasets.name: appts_by_office
queryLines:
SELECT
  office_name,
  total_appointments,
  no_show_count AS no_show,
  cancelled_count AS cancelled,
  no_show_rate_pct,
  total_revenue,
  denial_rate_pct
FROM
  wavepoint_workshop.project_3_gold.gold_office_performance
ORDER BY
  total_appointments DESC

datasets.name: visit_type
queryLines:
SELECT
  visit_type,
  SUM(total_appointments) AS visit_count
FROM
  wavepoint_workshop.project_3_gold.gold_appointment_analytics
GROUP BY
  visit_type
ORDER BY
  visit_count DESC

datasets.name: revenue_by_category
queryLines:
SELECT
  procedure_category,
  SUM(total_allowed) AS total_allowed,
  SUM(insurance_portion) AS insurance_amount,
  SUM(patient_portion) AS patient_amount,
  SUM(line_count) AS line_count
FROM
  wavepoint_workshop.project_3_gold.gold_revenue_by_procedure
GROUP BY
  procedure_category
ORDER BY
  total_allowed DESC

datasets.name: recall_effectiveness
queryLines:
SELECT
  recall_type,
  SUM(total_sent) AS total_sent,
  SUM(appointments_created) AS resulted,
  ROUND(AVG(conversion_rate_pct), 1) AS conversion_rate
FROM
  wavepoint_workshop.project_3_gold.gold_recall_effectiveness
GROUP BY
  recall_type
ORDER BY
  conversion_rate DESC

datasets.name: balance_by_office
queryLines:
SELECT
  office_name,
  outstanding_patient_balance AS total_patient_balance,
  total_revenue
FROM
  wavepoint_workshop.project_3_gold.gold_office_performance
ORDER BY
  total_patient_balance DESC

datasets.name: noshow_by_age
queryLines:
SELECT
  p.age_group,
  COUNT(*) AS total_appointments,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN a.is_no_show THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS no_shows,
  ROUND(
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN a.is_no_show THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    )
      * 100.0
      / COUNT(*),
    1
  ) AS no_show_rate
FROM
  wavepoint_workshop.project_3_silver.appointments a
    JOIN wavepoint_workshop.project_3_silver.patients p
      ON a.patient_id = p.patient_id
GROUP BY
  p.age_group
ORDER BY
  p.age_group
